Active References Lock:

- Reference 2: Damien, midnight-black cashmere overcoat (100% match Reference 2).
- Reference 3: Checkered marble foyer (100% match Reference 3).

[0.0s - 4.2s] SHOT A: Claire enters, says finishing before 3.9s: "Good morning. As of eight A.M., the takeover is complete."

[4.2s - 10.0s] HARD CUT TO SHOT B - TIGHT CLOSE-UP: Claire says finishing before 9.3s: "Every account, every contract, frozen."
